function.name: PdfTools.extract_text
function.description: Extract the complete text layer from a PDF file stored in the VM with explicit page markers. Text up to 1000 characters is returned directly; longer text is saved to the fixed searchable pdf.txt path documented in the PDF skill. This operation does not render page images.

vm_path.description: Absolute path of the PDF inside the VM. In API calls, use forward slashes for Windows paths, for example C:/Users/Docker/Desktop/document.pdf, to avoid Python backslash escape errors.

function.name: PdfTools.render_page
function.description: Render one selected PDF page as a PNG in the VM and return that image directly to the model for mandatory visual verification. Every task that derives an answer or output from a PDF must render and inspect each relevant source page before committing the result or terminating.

vm_path.description: Absolute path of the PDF inside the VM, using forward slashes for Windows paths.

page_number.description: One-based physical PDF page number to render.

image_dpi.description: Resolution of the rendered PNG returned to the model. Defaults to 144 DPI.
